title: [CLS] is Not Enough: Multi-Label Recognition via Patch-Level Inference and Adaptive Aggregation
institutions: Kunming University of Science and Technology
core_contribution: Training-free multi-label recognition via patch-level inference + adaptive aggregation; replaces single [CLS] token with dense patch predictions fused by global-local weighting
key_mechanisms: Patch-based Visual Classifier Learning (PVCL): unsupervised GDA classifier from patch embeddings, no backprop
Three-stage purification: entropy-guided bootstrapping -> vision-driven purification -> robust shrinkage induction
Prediction Adaptive Aggregation (PAA): category-wise max-pool over patches -> Softmax recalibration -> convex fusion with [CLS]
Global-local fusion weight alpha=0.9: patch evidence for small objects, [CLS] anchor for large/salient objects
Bank size K=512 optimal: top-K patches by min entropy; beyond 512 introduces noise
Training-free: single forward pass, no gradient updates, no parameter fine-tuning

sovereign_stack_mappings.role: Direct architectural analog: [CLS] = collapsed single-hex toy oracle; patch-level = full 64-hex expansion; PAA = consult consensus/porosity-weighted aggregation
integration_points: Replace collapse_full_128() single-dominant selection with patch-level inference: all 64 hexes = 64 patches
PVCL = unsupervised visual classifier from patch embeddings = emotional_engine.py consensus from resolved vectors
PAA = adaptive aggregation: category-wise max-pool over 64 hex scores -> Softmax -> convex fusion with [CLS] global anchor
Alpha=0.9 matches King Wen bias toward local patch evidence (hex-level) with global [CLS] anchor (consensus hexagram)
Bank size K=512 = full 512 resolved states; no sampling, no truncation
Entropy-guided bootstrapping = porosity-weighted hex selection; low entropy = high confidence patch/hex
Training-free = deterministic batch-only; no RNG, no learned coordinate predictor in Tensor Memory

sovereign_stack_mappings.role: Multi-label consult routing: patch-level = per-hex tool routing; adaptive aggregation = Jarvis tool selection + execution
integration_points: Consult tool returns all 64 hex scores, not single winner -> PAA aggregates to tool routing decision
Patch embeddings = per-hex skill card vectors; [CLS] = global user intent vector
PVCL reduces modality gap between hex vectors and tool execution requirements
Alpha=0.9 means 90% weight on local hex evidence, 10% on global anchor

sovereign_stack_mappings.role: Training-free inference pattern for per-hex classification heads; GDA closed-form classifier avoids backprop
integration_points: Per-hex head uses PVCL-style GDA classifier from patch embeddings = training-free weight estimation
Bank size K=512 patches per hex = full 512 resolved states as training-free classifier input
No gradient updates = deterministic inference; matches King Wen zero-roll requirement
Adaptive aggregation = per-hex head outputs fused by learned alpha weight

sovereign_stack_mappings.role: Multi-label cache classification: patch-level = per-loc/item/npc patch classification; [CLS] = global cache summary
integration_points: Cache extraction patches = image patches; PVCL learns visual classifier from cache embeddings
Loc/item/npc classification without training: entropy-guided patch selection from cache binaries
Adaptive aggregation fuses per-patch classification with global cache summary

technical_alignment.determinism: Fully training-free = no backprop, no learned weights in inference; matches King Wen zero-roll requirement
technical_alignment.patch_level_inference: 64 hex expansion = 64 patches; each hex provides local discriminative evidence
technical_alignment.adaptive_aggregation: PAA = consult consensus + porosity-weighted routing; convex fusion with global anchor
technical_alignment.modality_gap: PVCL = emotional_engine.py consensus; bridges hex vector space to tool execution space
technical_alignment.bank_size: K=512 matches full 512 resolved states; no truncation, no sampling
technical_alignment.entropy_selection: Porosity-weighted hex selection = low entropy = high confidence patch/hex

implementation_priority: Phase 1: Wire PAA-style aggregation into kingwen_oracle_consult_tool.py (all 64 hex scores -> alpha fusion -> single routing decision)
Phase 2: Add PVCL-style GDA classifier to emotional_engine.py for training-free consensus refinement
Phase 3: Extend Tensor Memory to store patch embeddings + classifier weights in 8x8x8 grid
Phase 4: rsmv-upstream cache classification with entropy-guided patch selection
